notes:
THE FINDING - INV-46: the LOCK-rotation rendezvous is generic over N, but THREE separate places in the toolchain had N=2 baked in, and NONE announced itself. Each produced a layout that built and routed cleanly, then misbehaved for a reason pointing somewhere else:
  (1) cpsat_placer constrained only the first two drivers (hardcoded drvs[0], drvs[1]) and skipped multi-cell blocks via a len(pl.cells) != 1 gate;
  (2) bus_router reused ONE broker per target cell - for a face-locking target that reuse IS the same-face bug, delivering two arms on one face;
  (3) build hardcoded CONFIG 4 (LOCK) as the backward-unlock target, silently REWRITING an authored WRITE.CFG @N,3 (LOCK_FACE re-point) into a lock-CLEAR - it voted correctly for two samples then desynced. Fixed with an opt-in UNLOCK_CFG_ADDR class attribute so existing serialize-LOCK blocks are untouched.

THE GOVERNING CONSTRAINT IS A FACE BUDGET: an N-arm rendezvous needs N arms + 1 forward + 1 release corridor = N + 2 faces, against a cell's 4. N=2 fits (and the shipped N=2 blocks are single-cell, so it never surfaced). N=3 needs FIVE, which is why this block is a 4-cell colinear chain with the rendezvous as a LEAF of the fold, forced into the longitudinal strip layout_rules warns about, and why its serialize-lock release cannot have its own corridor and must ride the one abutting cell. N >= 4 is NOT placeable as a single rendezvous - it needs a tree.

INV-19 EARNED ITS KEEP TWICE: it caught that the OBVIOUS construction (re-lock to face_a at the end of the last arm) deadlocks after exactly one packet - the rotation needs N+1 stops, not N - and then that the residual one-triple-in-flight limit is the same face budget wall, recorded as an executable guard naming three measured alternative release points and why each is blocked.

VERIFICATION: 55 gates at EXACT tolerance 0 on the real placed+routed+built chip - all five vote cases, all 6 relative arrival orders producing identical streams, random interleavings over 3 seeds, edge values, the fault_sentinel param, startup/stall semantics, all 8 D4 orientations with 0 xfails, and every INV-4 mutation proven to fail including the mandatory negative (fault injection disabled -> status channel asserted FLAT ZERO, which catches a voter emitting a constant fault code).

ORCHESTRATOR VERIFICATION: 55 gates pass from main; the two N=2 sibling blocks (DualFloatToComplex, FeaturePairJoin) are UNREGRESSED at 40 passed, which is the real test of three engine changes that touch every design; placekyt/tests green. Both engine diffs reviewed and judged principled - each is scoped to blocks declaring NEEDS_DISTINCT_INPUT_FACES or UNLOCK_CFG_ADDR, with getattr defaults preserving existing behaviour.

NUMBERING COLLISION CAUGHT AT LANDING: this block and ChaCha20QRBlock ran in PARALLEL worktrees and both independently claimed INV-45. Resolved by keeping BOTH and renumbering this one to INV-46. A parallel-wave hazard worth knowing: concurrent builders cannot see each other's KB additions, so the orchestrator must reconcile invariant numbers at landing.

BUILDER CAVEAT CARRIED FORWARD: its own verification/tests/ full-suite runs stalled twice with no output, so it verified 1164 tests across the seven most relevant files rather than the whole suite. Orchestrator is running the full sweep independently.
